channel.title: Unread
channel.description:
UNREAD: stories you haven't heard yet.

Every video is a story waiting to be opened. Some will keep you up at night. Some will help you fall asleep. Some will teach you something you never knew.

😱 SCARY STORIES
Short horror told through the screen in your hand. A text from a number you don't know. A call at 3:07 AM that says "turn around." Best watched alone, in the dark, with the volume up.

🌙 BEDTIME STORIES
Gentle, calm stories for kids and grown-ups. Kind characters, soft voices and cozy sounds for story time, quiet time or falling asleep.

💡 DID YOU KNOW?
Short, surprising facts and true stories about the world, science, history and the things around us.

📺 New stories every week. Pick a playlist and start reading.
🔔 Subscribe so you never leave a story unread.

Got a story idea, a creepy text, or a question you want answered? Drop it in the comments. It might become the next Unread.

Scary stories are fiction. Probably.
